The case is handed off to ops. The investigator found that `OrderRepository`'s constructor fails at startup because `data/orders.csv` is not at `/app/data/orders.csv` in the deployed environment. The code in `GetOrder` is not the cause, and the investigator rated its confidence high. The runbook row for a missing or misplaced data file gives hand-off to ops.

The investigator also noticed a separate code issue: `GetOrder` reads `order.Items[0]`, so order 1006, which has no items, would throw instead of returning "0 items". That is not behind this error, so it needs its own case.
